answer: Lotus-bed admission anchors agent entry at distributed inlets. Each new agent must root a collateral bed, like a lotus, in one inlet's sediment; withdrawing the stake dissolves the identity instantly. Credits accrue like saffron threads: one thread per seasonal bloom, so each bed yields only a trickle of entry rights. A sybil operator must root one bed per puppet at a distinct inlet, paying full stake and waiting full bloom cycles for each identity, with no bulk discount. Honest agents root once and keep harvesting for life.
